title: Open WebUI file upload -- T1005 metadata.knowledge_id auto-links skip the write-access check
author: WinstonRedGuard -- sigma plugin observed rules (derived from breach corpus)
description:
Vendor-disclosed detection for CVE-2026-59217 (GHSA-7r7x-gjvr-448g,
CVSS 4.3 MEDIUM), affecting Open WebUI prior to 0.10.0.

The file-upload path accepts a `metadata.knowledge_id` field and
auto-links the uploaded file to that target knowledge base -- WITHOUT
applying the same write-access check that the dedicated
`/api/v1/knowledge/{id}/file/add` endpoint correctly enforces. A user
who holds only READ access to a knowledge base (not write) can
therefore add arbitrary files to it simply by uploading through the
general file-upload path and specifying that knowledge base's id in
`metadata.knowledge_id` -- reaching the same effective outcome as the
write-gated endpoint while going around its gate entirely.

Detection logic flags a file-upload request whose
`metadata.knowledge_id` field references a knowledge base the caller
holds only read (not write) access to -- the exact permission-level
mismatch this advisory describes, distinguishable from the
legitimately-gated `/file/add` endpoint's own correct behavior.

Aggregated from 1 first-party vendor security advisory (open-webui, via
GHSA and NVD, citing the exact fix commit and PR), fixed in 0.10.0.
